_how: One block per painting, in walking order. Put the photo in originals/ and add a block. Moods: midday, afternoon, dusk, blue, night. room and collections are optional. Then run: npm run build

paintings.title: Summer, Left Open
paintings.note: Every summer had a window like this, open all afternoon, the field almost too bright to look at. I kept the room dim so the outside could do all the shining. The bear keeps watch so the boy doesn’t have to.
paintings.alt: A child seen from behind stands in a dim room before a wide open window. A small teddy bear sits on the sunlit sill, and beyond it lies a golden wheat field under a blue summer sky with white clouds.

paintings.title: Where the Poppies Lean
paintings.note: I painted the poppies loosely on purpose, the way you remember flowers rather than see them. She’s walking away from us, but not sadly. She has just found the quiet part of the field and isn’t ready to share it.
paintings.alt: A girl in a long white dress, seen from behind, walks through tall pale grass scattered with red poppies, with dark green trees around her and a pale sky above.

paintings.title: For Later
paintings.note: White roses set down on cool stone, and a hand already moving on. I cropped the figure so the flowers would be what you remember. Some things you put somewhere safe, to come back to later.
paintings.alt: White roses with green stems lie across a grey stone ledge. Above them, the sleeve and hand of a figure in a pale coat move out of the frame, against soft green grass.

paintings.title: The Long Way Home
paintings.note: The road bends one way and she keeps to the other, holding more wildflowers than she can carry. I remember being that small and that sure of the way. The sky was the color of the inside of a shell, so I took my time with it.
paintings.alt: A small child with a blonde ponytail walks away down a dusty road at dusk, carrying an armful of wildflowers past tall reddish grasses, under a pale pink sky.

paintings.title: Someone Is Up Late
paintings.note: A rooftop, a lit window, and someone sitting outside it long after everyone else has gone to bed. I like not knowing why they’re still awake. The moon behind the tree is the only one keeping them company.
paintings.alt: A deep blue evening sky with a pale moon behind a dark leafy tree. On a rooftop terrace beside a brick building, a small figure sits in front of a warmly glowing arched window.

paintings.title: The Light Left On
paintings.note: A small house under a big tree, one window still lit. Out front, someone sits in the blue dark with an empty chair beside them. Whoever left the light on did it so somebody could find their way back.
paintings.alt: A dark house under a large tree at night, with one warmly lit window. Nearby, a small figure sits on a chair beside an empty one, against a misty blue-grey sky.
